name: label-filters
description: An invented Gmail account whose messages, from two senders, carry a work label, a personal label, both or neither, for the filters that share or hide by label or by person, and an invented Drive whose files sit in a tree of folders, in two folders at once or in none, for the filters that share or hide by folder. Every record carries the word zqfilter and a title and body of its own, so a test can state exactly which records a filter leaves.
